correction_1_strict_freshness.exact_invalid_message: Freshness cannot be confirmed because the generation timestamp or freshness threshold is invalid.
correction_1_strict_freshness.validation: generated_at_utc must be a nonempty canonical UTC ISO string (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.sss]Z, Z only), parse to finite, and round-trip to a real calendar date (rejects tz-less, offset, permissive non-ISO, impossible dates). freshness_threshold_hours must be a positive integer (rejects 0/negative/nonnumeric/fractional/missing). Missing metadata now uses the same invalid message (no separate missing-timestamp warning).
